title: Japanese-Style Stew with Hearty Tofu
description: A hearty and comforting Japanese-inspired stew made with dense tofu and a blend of spices, perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add grated ginger and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add diced tofu and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add chopped green onions, soy sauce, and water. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add diced potatoes and cook for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Season with sesame seeds and serve hot.
